title: Falcons sign TE Nick Muse to 53-man roster, put DL Da'Shawn Hand on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Falcons sign TE Nick Muse to 53-man roster, put DL Da'Shawn Hand on IR
sources.description: Falcons defensive lineman Da'Shawn Hand suffered a season-ending quad injury in the season opener and the Falcons moved him off the active roster on Wednesday.
